rot.ideia.ex1.e1: Now the black king has a knight. Even so, the two rooks give mate without help from your king.
rot.ideia.ex1.e2: The rook on a7 cuts the king off on the last rank. The other rook can give the check on the edge.
rot.ideia.ex1.e3: First, check the knight: from d4, it cannot reach the last rank to step into the check's path.
rot.ideia.ex1.certo: Checkmate! One rook cuts the seventh, the other closes the eighth, and the knight cannot help.
rot.ideia.ex1.revela: The rook goes to b8 and checks on the edge. The other guards the seventh. It is mate.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.a7a8.1: It is check, but the rook left the seventh and freed the king.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.a7a8.2: The black king escapes to g7.
rot.ideia.ex1.err.a7a8.3: Let's go back: one rook stays on the seventh, and the other gives the check.
rot.ideia.ex1.fora: That move does not give mate. Let's go back to the position.
rot.ideia.ex1.l1: Remember: before the check, see whether the knight can block the check or capture a rook.
rot.ideia.ex2.e1: Look at the knight on d6: no black piece protects it. The black king is far away.
rot.ideia.ex2.e2: An unprotected piece gets captured. Without the knight, the easy two-rook mate is left.
rot.ideia.ex2.p: Find the best move, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.certo: That's right! The rook captures the knight. Now it is two rooks against a lone king.
rot.ideia.ex2.revela: The d1 rook captures the knight on d6. The black king is left alone.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.a1a8.1: It is check, but the king steps out, and the knight stays in the game.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.a1a8.2: The black king goes to g7.
rot.ideia.ex2.err.a1a8.3: Let's go back: first capture the loose knight.
rot.ideia.ex2.fora: That move leaves the knight in the game. Let's go back to the position.
rot.ideia.ex2.volta: Find the best move, or click {verResposta}
rot.ideia.ex2.l1: Now I will show the rook ladder and how to escape the knight's attack.
rot.demos.escada.e1: This is the ladder: one rook cuts a rank, the other checks on the next one, and the king climbs.
rot.demos.escada.l1: The h1 rook goes to h4 and cuts the fourth rank.
rot.demos.escada.l2: The black king goes to d5.
rot.demos.escada.l3: Check on the fifth! The black king must climb.
rot.demos.escada.l4: The black king climbs to c6.
rot.demos.escada.l5: Check on the sixth! The king climbs again.
rot.demos.escada.l6: The king goes to b7, close to the a-file.
rot.demos.escada.l7: On a7, the king would capture the rook. It first goes to the other side.
rot.demos.escada.l8: The black king goes to c7.
rot.demos.escada.l10: The black king reaches the last rank.
rot.demos.escada.l11: Checkmate on the eighth! The knight stayed far away and could not help.
rot.demos.garfo.e1: Now the b4 knight attacks the a2 rook. If it stays, it will be captured.
rot.demos.garfo.l1: The rook escapes to a5: far from the knight, and it still cuts the fifth rank.
rot.demos.garfo.l2: Remember: rooks far from the knight and far from the black king. If the knight is unprotected, capture it.
rot.pratica.degrau.enunciado: Give checkmate. The h7 rook cuts the king off. Look at the knight before giving check.
rot.pratica.degrau.fim: Perfect. The knight could not reach the last rank.
rot.pratica.degrau.err.h7h8: It is check, but the rook left the seventh, and the king escapes. Try again.
rot.pratica.degrau.err.a1a7: Careful: the b5 knight captures the rook on a7. Try again.
rot.pratica.centro.enunciado: Build the ladder, with the rooks far from the knight. If it is unprotected, capture it.
rot.pratica.centro.fim: Well done. The rooks beat the knight.
